name: photo-to-zine-postcard
title_zh: 把一张照片变成可邮寄的双面明信片
tagline_zh: 照片塞进信封太可惜？两分钟生成极简 zine 明信片：正面保留原图，背面有手绘纹样、色卡和可写地址栏。
tagline_en: Don't just print photos—mail them. Turn any snapshot into a minimal 2:3 zine postcard with hand-drawn motifs.
desc_en: Turn a user-provided photograph into a minimal two-sided 2:3 zine-style postcard. Preserve the original photo above, then create a sparse hand-drawn source-specific motif, minimal metadata, three sampled color swatches, and a matching functional postcard back.
why_zh: 不是套滤镜，而是从照片里提取专属纹样和色卡，让背面设计跟着原图长出来，每张都独一无二。
why_en: It doesn't slap on a filter—it extracts motifs and swatches from your actual photo, so every card's back grows out of the image.
limit_zh: 只处理单张横竖皆可的照片；输出为 PDF 版式，不负责印刷拼版。若原图分辨率低于 1200px，背面纹样会显得粗糙。
limit_en: Single photo in/out as PDF layout; no print imposition. Below 1200px source, motifs get visibly coarse.
